idea-plugin.name: Catppuccin Latte Warm
idea-plugin.description:
Warm Catppuccin Latte Theme for JetBrains IDEs

A customized warm variant of Catppuccin Latte featuring soothing yellow/parchment ivory background tones in place of the default cool blue slate.

Features

  • Warm Parchment Backgrounds: Replaces cold blue-tinted grays with warm ivory and cream tones (#fbf5e6, #f4eedf, #ebdcc9).
  • Warm Espresso Typography: Crisp dark coffee text (#4a4035) with excellent contrast against warm backgrounds.
  • Harmonious Accents: Beautiful Catppuccin pastel syntax highlights (Mauve, Peach, Teal, Green, Lavender, Yellow).
  • Islands UI & Standard UI Support: Includes both standard and Islands theme variants.
  • Italics & Non-Italics Options: Bundles both standard italicized and non-italicized editor color schemes.

Usage

User Interface

  • Head to Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance
  • Select Catppuccin Latte Warm

Editor Color Scheme

  • Head to Settings → Editor → Color Scheme
  • Select Catppuccin Latte Warm or Catppuccin Latte Warm (no italics)
